marc:datafield.marc:subfield: 趁早出发 | Chen zao chu fa

is a book that chronicles the author's travel addiction process, which began in 2016 with a poor trip to Vietnam, a solo birthday in Myanmar and Laos, and a companionable half-marathon run to Angkor Wat in Cambodia. The book details traveling poorly in Vietnam for up to six weeks, the 21-kilometer experience of Angkor Wat, the adventure of driving alone for his birthday in Myanmar, and the 100-year old Booze in Luang Prabang, Laos.
The book chronicles the author's youthful exploration of the world, sketching the confused, ignorant, and cocky side of youth while showcasing the cities, people, food, and sights traveled through. A gift for anyone who wants to embark on a journey, it may not give you practical travel tips, but hopefully it will at least give you the courage to take the first step.
